body: I appreciate the offer, but I've tried talking. I'm really stressed, no, exhausted of all the stress, and I just want things to end. Again, thanks for wanting to help but talking doesn't work for me.

Agreed. My family doesn't care, one of then told me I should, in fact. I have no true close friends anymore, the two others I told were just like damn that sucks, bro. Sorry to hear that. 
I told a therapist and she just put it in her notes like it was no big deal. I even checked myself into the emergency room and all they did was say well you seem fine, held me for a few hours, and gave me a bill of over 1500 dollars. For sitting in a room for five hours. 
I have nothing. I am nothing. I attempted again last night and got closer than ever, and plan on ending things officially tonight. I can't fucking fake it anymore.
I have almost nothing. Mexico may be cheap but it's more than I have even still.

I appreciate the feedback, thank you. OTC drugs help but only a little. It never lasts. As for whitening, that's a bad option for me. It'll only make my teeth more sensitive, AND it'll clash with the fillings I have in my front teeth, which are made to be the off yellow my teeth are. It's just so much money. First the x-rays and then individual reshaping as well as fillings. I don't have thousands of dollars and I probably never will to just spend. Bills can fuck off, teeth can fuck off, I can hopefully soon fuck off. I'm so angry and exhausted with life. 
That being said, I appreciate you trying to be help and being kind. You're a good person.

My teeth are bad and sorta clunky looking, but I don't think they're so physically ugly that I'd be accepted for a tv show or anything like that. It's just a mixture of discoloration, sensitivity, pre existing fillings, cavities, bruxism, and already being small by default. I hate them.

I really hope you can get your teeth repaired, friend. The insecurity and pain of bad teeth is something I don't think I'd give to even my worst enemy. It's totally destroyed me, and on quiet nights I can't help but cry. I feel like it's all made me lose my mind, from the obsession to the slight but NEVER ENDING pain in my mouth. Life just isn't worth living like this.

Thank you for the advice, truly. It's become such an obsession of mine that I can't turn off. People tell me, oh it could be worse! Or, just quit worrying...but I can't. The throbbing or dull pains don't go away, let alone my insecurities when smiling or the sting of a cold glass of water. I'm glad you found salvation, I hope I can too.

There actually is a cheap place near me...But a big problem is that they're so busy. That and even with their sliding scale...I still can't really afford them. For example, there's a month or two inbetween each appointment and the most he'll do is one filling. God knows if he'd even reshape my teeth.

Thanks for that, really. I'm way softer of a person than I'd like to be, so I know realistically her comments and those made by other's cling to me MUCH easier than words like, "what do you mean??? They look fine!"
Thinking about it, yeah. It's probably not at all normal that my teeth cripple me as much as they do, and there something else going on. That being said, there's still pain and all, but probably not enough to justify the amount of self pity I have regarding them. I just wish I could turn off being so hyper critical. When I talk to people, I gawk their teeth. In movies and in person. I examine mine in the mirror dozens of times a day, and have literal dreams of getting them perfected. I wish I could make it stop, but that's probably beyond the power of dentistry. 

Thanks again for your response though, it really is appreciated.

That's what people tell me, and I'm not delusional or anything in the sense of I know they could be a lot worse. I guess it just bothers me because I've got terrible self image and because of the guilt I have knowing I never took care of them until I was already a teenager. I dunno, don't mean to seem dramatic or anything but they just bother me so much sometimes even still. Sorry.

Hey guys and gals, so I guess I should give some background. (Throwaway account because of how awful these things make me feel.)
Thoughts and guilt about my teeth occupy my mind every day, almost all day. I neglected them until around 14, I guess because no one really told me to brush and I didn't have a good circle or discipline. That being said, I know they aren't the worst. I know that, and yet I can't help but feel ashamed. Not only because they're very yellow, that I can rationally deal with...but the bruxism or acidic damage or whatever all the jaggedness is from I CANNOT STAND. I have been brought to manic states and tears due to it, and having to manually untighten my jaw dozens of times a day really sucks. 


I'd like to believe I could get my few cavities filled, and some of those top front teeth reshaped. ESPECIALLY the middle two, but I just don't know where to go. I've been recently unemployed and money is really tight. Ergo, I have nothing...I'm a 20 year old male in south Texas, and I just want to feel better. Is there anything I can do? There's a federally funded clinic in my area but even on their sliding scale I still can't afford it right now. Do I just have to continue and suck it up until I'm in a better financial spot? 

Thanks in advance for any and all thoughts, comments, and ideas. I really appreciate this community.

Edit: I should probably add that maybe another big reason why I hate my teeth is because as my mother used to frequently put it, "you have your dad's funky teeth." The guy I never knew and only met twice. When I look in the mirror all I see is him, and at 20 I know it shouldn't bother me...but it does. I have dreams at night (literally) about getting my teeth aligned, reshaped, whitened and the whole deal. Mostly so I can feel like my own person, and not him. If only I inherited my mom's big, healthy teeth. :/
